repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-team
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.team for Webex teams on the conversation service. create() resolves participants to uuids (creator first), builds a conversation-shaped payload with objectType 'team', and POSTs it to the conversation service resource teams; get(), list() (including the additionalUrls hosts), and listConversations() read teams and their conversations and record member uuids; createConversation() and joinConversation() create and join team conversations, granting the general conversation's KMS resource access to new ones. Membership, moderator, conversation, archive, and field changes are activities posted to the team's general conversation through webex.internal.conversation. Importing the package also registers payload transforms that encrypt a team's displayName and summary with a new KMS key, decrypt them and the team's conversations on the way in, normalize its lists, and decrypt teamRoomStatus events. It stores nothing itself.

team-internal-sdk.summary: Published npm package (internal plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations are published. Importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-conversation, @webex/internal-plugin-user, and @webex/internal-plugin-encryption, then registers Team as internal plugin 'team' with config {team: {}} and a payloadTransformer of one inbound predicate (decryptTeamRoomStatus) and six transforms (decryptTeam, decryptTeamRoomStatus, decryptPropSummary, encryptTeam, encryptPropSummary, normalizeTeam); the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default Team class. webex.internal.team exposes create, get, list, listConversations, createConversation, joinConversation, addConversation, removeConversation, addMember, removeMember, assignModerator, unassignModerator, archive, unarchive, and update, plus underscore-prefixed helpers; specified in src/docs/README.md.

conversation-teams-http.source: Conversation service (catalog service name conversation, reached through service: 'conversation' and api: 'conversation' in src/team.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
conversation-teams-http.summary: POST teams with a conversation-shaped creation payload of objectType 'team'; GET <team.url> and GET teams (also <additionalUrl>/teams) with query includeTeamConversations and includeTeamMembers; GET <team.url>/conversations resolving items; POST <team.url>/conversations with optional query includeAllTeamMembers; POST <team.url>/conversations/<id>/participants with a kmsMessage that carries the device url and the supertoken access token as the KMS client credential.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-008, MOD-013, MOD-037, MOD-044; code consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/webex-core.js)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerInternalPlugin keys the plugin by its raw name (team, first registration wins) and concatenates its payloadTransformer predicates and transforms into the defaults; transform runs matching predicates and applyNamedTransform runs every transform with the given name whose direction matches or is unset; WebexPlugin supplies webex, namespaced config, logger, and request.

webex-core-services.summary: ServiceInterceptor maps api to service, requires resource and service, waits for the service, and joins its catalog URL with the resource; it leaves a request with uri unchanged.

internal-plugin-conversation-activities.source: @webex/internal-plugin-conversation (workspace package; no spec exists; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-conversation/src/conversation.js)
internal-plugin-conversation-activities.summary: prepare(activity, params) fills verb, kmsMessage, actor, object, and a target picked to id, url, objectType, kmsResourceObjectUrl, and defaultActivityEncryptionKeyUrl; submit(activity, endpoint) posts it; add, leave, update, assignModerator, and unassignModerator build and submit those activities; get({id}) fetches a conversation; getConvoUrl returns, for an object with generalConversationUuid, the url of that entry in conversations.items; prepareConversation picks a conversation reference; _prepareConversationForCreation builds the create and add activities and a KMS create /resources message.

internal-plugin-conversation-transforms.source: @webex/internal-plugin-conversation transforms (no spec exists; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-conversation/src/index.js, src/encryption-transforms.js, src/decryption-transforms.js)
internal-plugin-conversation-transforms.summary: transformObject runs normalizeObject, encryptObject, and encryptKmsMessage outbound and decryptObject then normalizeObject inbound for a body with objectType; decryptObject, encryptObject, and normalizeObject dispatch to decrypt<ObjectType>, encrypt<ObjectType>, and normalize<ObjectType>; decryptTextProp and encryptTextProp decrypt or encrypt one named property with a key; decryptPropDisplayName and encryptPropDisplayName are those for displayName.

internal-plugin-encryption-kms.summary: kms.createUnboundKeys({count}) resolves new unbound keys with a uri; encryptText(key, plaintext) and decryptText(key, ciphertext) encrypt and decrypt text with a key or key url.

internal-plugin-user-uuids.source: @webex/internal-plugin-user (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-user/src/docs/README.md MOD-002, MOD-003, MOD-006)
internal-plugin-user-uuids.summary: asUUID(user, {create: true}) returns uuids unchanged and resolves emails through getUUID, rejecting a cached entry without userExists for create callers; recordUUID(user) rejects a user without a uuid id or a valid email, else adds it to the store.
